name: BACH_0161_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and clean input, but the second model disagrees on the top class [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Invasive 2% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; lowers invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score fits in situ pattern · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 6) · context · Below-typical TILs; descriptive only [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region removal drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion test shows no effect (0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model's differing top class is correct; 98% comes from one probe.
- Simulated resample degradation (severity 3) distorts the image; reliability error AUROC is only 0.69.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 7** — highest per-region invasive probabilities (84%, 83%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Region 8** — strongest tumor-infiltrating-stroma score; check whether tumor extends beyond ducts.
3. **Regions 4, 5** — confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
